passive.name: Moonsilver Blade
passive.text: Every third strike cleaves nearby enemies for an additional magic damage. After casting a spell, Diana gains Attack Speed for 5 seconds.

spells.name: Crescent Strike
spells.text: Unleashes a bolt of lunar energy in an arc dealing magic damage.Afflicts enemies struck with Moonlight, revealing them if they are not stealthed for 3 seconds.

spells.name: Pale Cascade
spells.text: Diana creates three orbiting spheres that detonate on contact with enemies to deal damage in an area. She also gains a temporary shield that absorbs damage. If her third sphere detonates, the shield gains additional strength.

spells.name: Lunar Rush
spells.text: Becomes the living embodiment of the vengeful moon, dashing to an enemy and dealing magic damage.Lunar Rush has no cooldown when used to dash to an enemy afflicted with Moonlight. All other enemies will have the Moonlight debuff removed regardless of whether they were the target of Lunar Rush.

spells.name: Moonfall
spells.text: Diana reveals and draws in all nearby enemies and slows them.If Diana pulls in one or more enemy champions, the moonlight crashes down onto her after a short delay, dealing magic damage in an area around her, increased for each target beyond the first pulled.

damage.value: Diana deals mage-style burst damage with Q and her ultimate.

archetype.value: Diana is a jungle assassin who can also build as a mage tank.

winCondition.value: Diana can catch targets out of position and initiate fights.

spikes.why: Diana’s true burst damage does not arrive until level 6.
Diana can reset Lunar Rush’s cooldown to continue her engage.
Diana deals more damage for each champion pulled in.

bait.why: Diana’s Lunar Rush has a long cooldown without a Crescent Strike reset, leaving a window after she spends it.
When Diana spends Crescent Strike, its 8/7.5/7/6.5/6-second cooldown leaves her without its ranged damage and Moonlight application.

mistakes.value: Building Diana fully offensively leaves her vulnerable.
Diana players should not rely on an escape in a team fight beyond Flash.
Diana loses her dash reset when she uses Lunar Rush without first landing Crescent Strike.
